text:
WHAT THIS COULD LOOK LIKE

Less repetitive work.
More time for your business.

AI isn't always the answer.
The right approach starts with the problem.

Illustrative scenarios, not client case studies.

01
The same questions. Again.

AI-assisted drafting, an FAQ, or reusable email templates may be appropriate.

Make room for the human part
02
Less copying. More doing.

Formulas, scripts, or basic automation may work without AI.

Sometimes simpler is better
03
Find the useful bits.

AI-assisted summaries, templates, or a better process may help.
